window_monthly.end_rationale: The last month before the Oct-Nov 2025 US data-collection gap, which leaves a missing October 2025 value in the CPI series. Using one common end date avoids interpolating actuals.

note: FRED values can be revised; the SHA-256 pins the exact bytes used. Raw/processed data are git-ignored.

files.description: Derived: daily sums of 30 selected series (selection rule in data/series_list.json); not committed
files.selection_rule: eligible = series with at most 3 zero hourly values in the whole span (the zeros that occur at the March clock-change hour in each of the 3 years are tolerated) and no missing values; take 30 eligible series at evenly spaced positions floor(i * n_eligible / 30), i = 0..29, in the file's original order
files.aggregation: sum of hourly values per calendar day (UTC-naive timestamps as given)
